title: Credo (Colin, Missa Confitemini)
desc: Pierre Colin, Missa Confitemini, Credo, 1556. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0001_3); edited by Vincent Besson, Marco Gurrieri, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.

poly.lyr: Pa- trem o- mni- po- ten- tem, fac- to- rem cae- li et ter- . . . . rae, vi- si- bi- li- um o- mni- um et in- vi- si- bi- li- um. Fi- li- um De- i u- ni- . . . ge- ni- tum. Et ex Pa- tre na- tum an- te o- mni- a sae- . . . cu- . . . la. De- um de De- o, lu- men de lu- mi- ne, De- um ve- rum de De- o ve- ro. Per quem o- mni- a fa- . . . . . . cta sunt. Qui pro- pter nos ho- mi- . . . nes, et pro- pter no- stram sa- lu- tem des- cen- dit de cae- . . lis. ex Ma- ri- a Vir- gi- ne: Et ho- mo fa- . . ctus est. Cru- ci- fi- xus e- ti- am pro no- bis: sub Pon- ti- o . . . . Pi- . la- . to pas- sus, et se- pul- tus est. . . . . . Et a- scen- dit in cae- . . lum: se- det ad dex- te- ram Pa- . tris. cu- ius re- gni non e- rit fi- nis. Et in Spi- ri- tum San- ctum, Do- mi- num, et vi- vi- fi- can- . . . tem: qui ex Pa- tre Fi- li- o- que pro- ce- dit. Qui cum Pa- tre et Fi- li- . o si- mul a- do- ra- tur, et con- glo- ri- fi- ca- . . . tur: . . . . . . Et u- nam san- ctam ca- tho- li- cam et a- po- sto- li- cam Ec- cle- si- am. Con- fi- te- or u- num ba- pti- sma in re- mis- si- o- nem pec- ca- to- rum. Et ex- pe- cto re- sur- re- cti- o- nem mor- tu- o- . . . rum. Et vi- tam ven- tu- ri . . . . sae- cu- li. A- men.
